content: Good, morning! Can I help you?
Good morning. Could you tell me the times of trains to London, please?
Yes. There are trains at seven fifty-nine, nine eighteen, ten thirty-two and eleven fifty-five.
What time does the seven fifty-nine get to London?
At nine thirty-six. And the nine eighteen gets to London at nine fifty-five, the ten thirty-two at eleven nine.
What about coming back? I'd like to come back about 7 p. m.
There's one at nineteen and the next is at nineteen forty.
